atc_utterance: Speedbird 342, cleared ILS runway 34 left approach, descend to altitude 3000 feet on QNH 1013, report established on the localizer.
expected_readback: Cleared ILS runway 34 left approach, descend to 3000 feet, QNH 1013, wilco, Speedbird 342.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.7, Annex 10 Vol II
hint_tr: ILS approach clearance'da runway numarası, descend altitude ve QNH mutlaka readback edilmeli. 'Wilco' ile report talimatını kabul edin.
hint_en: For ILS approach clearance, read back the runway number, descent altitude, and QNH. Use 'wilco' to acknowledge the reporting instruction.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control, go ahead with your snag report for Tango Charlie Alpha Three Two Five.
expected_readback: Tango Charlie Alpha Three Two Five, left hydraulic system showing low pressure indication on ECAM, quantity normal, noted intermittent pump caution during taxi, requesting troubleshooting guidance.
hint_tr: Hydraulic system failure raporunda sistem adı (left/right), bulgu (low pressure), ECAM status ve quantity bilgisini sırayla verin. Troubleshooting guidance isteğini unutmayın.
hint_en: For hydraulic snag reports, state system side, observed symptom, ECAM status, fluid quantity, and request troubleshooting guidance in sequence.

atc_utterance: Cockpit, this is the purser. Cabin is secure, all passengers seated with seat belts fastened, carry-on stowed, doors armed and cross-checked. We are ready for pushback.
expected_readback: Roger purser, cabin secure, all passengers seated and belted, carry-on stowed, doors armed and cross-checked, ready for pushback.
hint_tr: Purser olarak flight deck'e pushback öncesi cabin durumunu rapor ediyorsun. Tüm kritik maddeleri sırayla tekrarla: cabin secure, passengers seated ve belted, carry-on stowed, doors armed.
hint_en: As purser reporting to flight deck before pushback, confirm all critical items in sequence: cabin secure status, passenger seating and belts, carry-on stowage, and door arming status.
